backend.source_model_description: CSV-to-RDF conversion with lightweight ontologies; SPARQL endpoint on Linked Data Finland; Sampo-UI JavaScript framework and Mapbox/OpenStreetMap

descriptions.interaction: Faceted search; browse individual finds or tables; switch analysis tabs; query authority/mint perspectives

descriptions.visualisation: Tables,interactive mint-to-findsite arc maps and comparative statistical pie charts
